notes_for_editor: The only source that places a tower here is OpenStreetMap, which names it a Lookout Tower and tags it observation. The FFLA Vermont list I read has no entry for Stave Island, and the local NHLR and FFLOS caches hold no record of it, so it is not confirmed as a fire lookout. Status 'standing' in the record rests only on the OSM point existing, not on any report of its condition. The OSM point is several hundred metres from the seaplane base coordinates in AeroCopilot (44.5959, -73.3476), so it may be a separate structure. Recommend a satellite check and a local source before any fire-lookout claim; the record's name and kind may need review. Access is unknown and no visit guidance is given.
